description: Recompute the hash chain of okgate's audit log (JSONL, one entry per tool call) and say whether any entry was edited, removed from the middle or reordered, naming the first broken entry. Returns the entry count and head hash; record both elsewhere, because entries cut from the end of the file still verify. Use it before trusting okgate_get_report. Takes no arguments: it checks the log the loaded policy names. Read-only; a log that does not exist yet verifies as empty.
name: okgate_verify_audit_log

broken_at.description: seq of the first entry that does not verify

configured.description: false when no policy file was found (okgate guards nothing)

exists.description: false when no call has been recorded yet; an absent log verifies

head_hash.description: hash of the last entry; record it with the count to detect entries cut from the end

ok.description: true when every entry's hash and prev_hash recompute

path.description: absolute path of the audit log checked

title: Verify okgate audit log
